output.summary: A small deciduous shrub native to Japan and eastern Asia. It has spiny brown branches, pale yellow spring flowers, leaves that turn red in autumn, and glossy red-to-orange edible berries that persist through winter. It is widely naturalized in China and North America and invasive in many places.
output.edibilityNote: The glossy red-to-orange berry is edible and matures from late summer through autumn.
